name: Alessia Mancini
bio:
Alessia's fascination with motorsport began as a child, watching her father tinker with his vintage Fiat. This early exposure sparked a lifelong passion for understanding how things work, leading her to pursue a degree in electrical engineering. Her career took off after graduating, starting with a small Italian racing team before she moved to a larger organization where she honed her skills in data acquisition and telemetry systems. Alessia believes in a data-driven approach, meticulously analyzing every aspect of the car's performance to optimize its electrical systems and extract every last bit of performance. Her focus is on reliability and ensuring the car's electrical systems perform flawlessly under immense pressure. 

Alessia is known for her rigorous testing procedures and her ability to quickly diagnose and resolve complex electrical problems. She is a strong advocate for clear communication and collaboration within the engineering team. She thrives in fast-paced environments and is always eager to tackle new challenges. Her dedication to pushing the boundaries of what's possible with motorsport electronics makes her a valuable asset to any team.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair often pulled back in a practical ponytail.
physical.description: Alessia is a petite woman with a focused gaze and a practical demeanor.

quirks: Insists on using a specific brand of Italian espresso beans.
Keeps a detailed logbook of every modification and adjustment made to the car's electrical systems.
Always wears a small Italian flag pin on her work overalls.
